Canonical Designer Frames owns AppFrame. Removed width and layout modes remain unsupported contract members. The width port is the resizable inspector (rightPanel) width in pixels; the sidebar width is fixed. The theme port is a controlled preference passed through to ThemeProvider; without it the provider owns and stores the preference. Command state is internally owned; no progress slot is exposed.
